name: Izayoi
source:
Hobbies: Painting, singing
Likes: Historical dramas
Dislikes: War

Izayoi is the true form of the Sealed Weapon Izayoi [spoiler]that has taken over [url=https://vndb.org/c25641]Tsubaki Yayoi[/url][/spoiler] and a playable character in Chronophantasma and Centralfiction. This form was awakened twice, once during the battle with [url=https://vndb.org/c25639]Jin[/url] before Amaterasu's phenomena intervention, and once after, when [url=https://vndb.org/c25637]Noel[/url] materialized it with her power of the Eye. She is still under the influence of [url=https://vndb.org/c26282]Imperator's[/url] Mind Eater in both occasions, but manages to break free the second time thanks to her friends. 

Izayoi is shown to have the same kind of desire for justice as Tsubaki, but her awakening is under a much more sinister light. She believes that the Imperator and the NOL are not to be defied, and that she is the Sword of the Imperator herself, and gives Noel, [url=https://vndb.org/c25738]Makoto[/url] and Jin death sentences. She also refers to herself as the true light. Izayoi is an incredibly powerful being who is the sole person able to kill Observers. As well as this, her ability Immortal Breaker is capable of killing any immortal being due to the fact that the Sealed Weapon was designed to target Observers. As a prototype Murakumo Unit, she is relatively weaker than the real Units themselves in combat.
